description_expanded: OverviewHot TubSteps to Private Beach Access, Beach Chairs Incl., Private Pool/Heat optionThe Space Dune Alright – Luxury Beachside Retreat with Private Pool & Gulf Views! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Private Deeded Beach Access – Just 40 yards from the beach stairs! Private Pool with Heat Option – Includes a lounging area with jets (not a hot tub) Expansive Outdoor Living Spaces – Multiple furnished decks with Gulf views Gated Water’s Edge Community – Exclusive, low-density beachside neighborhood Professionally Decorated & Custom Designed – Elegant coastal luxury throughout 3 Master Suites – Spacious bedrooms with private balconies & en-suite bathrooms Bunk Room for Kids – 2 sets of Twin-over-Full bunks with a private bath Top-Floor Media Room + Wet Bar – Perfect for family movie nights & entertaining Fully Equipped Gourmet Kitchen – Sub-Zero fridge, Wolf double oven, & 5-burner gas cooktop High-Speed Wi-Fi & Smart TVs in Every Room – Stay connected & entertained Dedicated Office Space – Private work area attached to the master suite Propane Grill for Outdoor Cooking – Perfect for vacation BBQs Driveway Parking for 2 Vehicles – Secure & convenient Walking Distance to Rosemary Beach & Alys Beach – Shops, dining, & entertainment nearby Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free vacationWelcome to Dune AlrightLocated in the lovely private Seacrest Beach gated community of Water’s Edge, adjacent to Rosemary Beach. This gorgeous vacation home is on the south side (beach side) of 30a, and is the 4th house back from the Gulf (40 yards from the beach stairs). This gated subdivision has only 35 homes, which allows for low density private beach access. A set of chairs with cocktail table and umbrella are provided on the beach for our guests. “Dune Alright” is a 5-bedroom+, 5 ½ bath vacation home with over 3,100 square feet. It is a 3-level private home with an office and media room. Beautiful tile floors throughout. It includes Free high speed wireless internet and has flat screen TVs in all bedrooms.The main floor has a gourmet kitchen with granite counter tops, 48' Sub-Zero Refrigerator, Wolf Double Convection Oven, Wolf 5 Burner Gas Cook Top, Microwave and Ice Maker. The open floor plan makes entertaining easy with a handmade reclaimed oak dining room table for ten, and a counter area that seats four. Relax in front of the 60-inch flat-screen TV with surround sound in the family room. A powder room is located just off the foyer.Stroll out back to the porch and patio area and enjoy a private pool that includes a 6-foot diameter in-pool lounging area (NOT A HOT TUB - even though it has jets that look like one) and has a state-of-the-art(saline) non chlorinated cleaning system. Bask in the Florida sun poolside, or take a short 40-yard stroll down a lovely landscaped, palm tree lined path to the beach stairs to enjoy the beautiful white sandy beach.This home has 3 master suites. The first-floor master is a large bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom with a granite counter. Strategically located away from the family room, this suite provides both privacy and convenience. Its location on the main floor makes it especially nice for anyone with reduced mobility concerns.The main master bedroom on the second floor is unbelievable! This large bedroom with king bed has a private porch that overlooks the pool & spa, an expansive bathroom with granite counter-tops, double vanities, soaking tub, and shower with bench. Attached to this bedroom is a private office that overlooks the pool. This office is multi-functional, as it can be used as a quiet reading space, work area, or nursery/young child’s sleeping area. The other second floor master has a king bed, and is also spacious and has a private deck with gulf view. The bathroom has granite double vanities and large shower. For the kids there is a Bunk room on this floor with 2 sets of Twin over Full Size Bunk Beds, that will accommodate four kids. It has its own private bathroom. A full-sized dedicated laundry room with extra-large capacity front loading washer/dryer is on this level.The 3rd Floor features a bedroom with two queen beds and a semi-private bathroom with a double vanity. There is also a media room with a 46” flat panel TV.There is a wet bar adjacent to the media room with a sink and mini-refrigerator. There are two large furnished decks on the 3rd floor which provide great views of the gulf and make a great spot to have a cocktail and watch the sun set over the beach.The gated community provides privacy and serenity for a relaxing vacation, yet is conveniently located within a 3-minute walk to Rosemary Beach restaurants, shops, and spa. There is a 17-mile walk/bike path located just outside our entrance, and fishing, sailing and kayaking are also available locally. The Publix food store is only about a 5-minute car ride east on 98. The new outdoor shopping area in Panama City, called Pier Park, is a 10-minute drive east on 98. Pier Park has numerous restaurants and stores, and a new state-of-the-art movie cinema. Seaside is 7 miles west, and the Sandestin Outlet Mall, Silver Sands, is about 20 miles west.'Dune Alright' is a custom designed, professionally decorated, and well-equipped home to make your vacation relaxing and memorable.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival****No Cable. Streaming Only**. Streaming and YouTube TV available* Pool heating available for this property from October 1st through May 1st* Fee $50 per day and required for length of stay* Pool heat is not guaranteed* 1 Set Beach Chair Service Included for stays March-Oct 2025* As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (16):First Floor Master - King sized bed, private bathroomSecond Floor Master - King sized bed, private bathroomSecond Floor Guest - King sized bed, shared bathroomSecond Floor Bunk - Two sets of twin over full beds, shared bathroomThird Floor Master - Two queen beds, private bathroomAREA ATTRACTIONS:This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand.A lively community gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.Show less
